auc_by_stream.definition: AUC of g_q (P1-D, eligible test units, mean over 3 seeds); in-domain g_mal / L1 AUC 0.99-1.00 partly reflects the CIC-background vs IoT-23-foreground dataset contrast (domain shortcut, P1-D notes), not only attack detectability

definitions.gm_pos: geometric mean of Var_d/Var_U1 over pairs where both are > 0
definitions.lcb_ratio: per scenario sum_q (Q - L+)/Q under the design / the same under U1 (mean over 500 reps, final epoch, rho = 5%), geometric mean over scenarios, cluster bootstrap
definitions.relmse_ratio: per scenario: sum_q Var_d(q)/Q_q^2 / sum_q Var_U1(q)/Q_q^2 over its estimands (classes D, S with Q > 0; the utility's equal-weight objective, Prop. design (b)); Var = analytic sum f^2(1-pi)/pi of the budget-matched designs (seed-averaged); adaptive U6/U6tau = empirical MSE over 500 MC reps (rho = 5% only, as deployed, spend/target reported); summary = geometric mean over scenarios, 95% CI = cluster bootstrap over scenarios with estimands nested (2,000 resamples)
definitions.seed_sd: s.d. over the 3 utility seeds of the per-scenario relmse_ratio, averaged over scenarios
definitions.share_exact: share of (scenario, estimand) pairs where the design retains every hit unit with probability 1 (Var = 0: the total is known exactly)
definitions.unit: test scenario (stream); in-domain = 6 LOSO LP-IoT23 streams at p = 1%; zero-shot = LP-Edge (0.97%), LP-Gotham thinned (1.09%) and natural (15.3%)
definitions.worst_pair_ratio: max over pairs of Var_d/Var_U1 (inflation); worst_vwr = max of sum f^2/pi ratios (Remark bound 1/tau_eff: 5.0001 for tau = 0.2, 2 for tau = 0.5)
definitions.worst_rv_ratio: per scenario max_q Var_d/Q^2 over max_q Var_U1/Q^2 (minimax objective), geometric mean over scenarios

inflation_vs_1pcv2.definition: geometric mean over scenarios (and seeds) of the measured V^wr inflation vs the oracle U7 (sum a°^2/pi, budget-matched designs) and of the unclipped prediction 1 + CV^2_w(a°/a), w ~ a sqrt(s) (Remark); per stream in E3_inflation.parquet

ks_shift_zero_shot.definition: two-sample KS statistic train (all IoT-23 + CIC training half) vs test payload-unit features, seed-0 model (P1-D ks.json)

mixture_bound_check.definition: max over (scenario, rho, seed, estimand) of V^wr(design)/V^wr(U1); Remark bound 1/tau_eff = 5.0001 (tau = 0.2, t16 = 13107) and 2 (tau = 0.5)
